authorityRoot.input: one array entry per normalized route.nodes item
authorityRoot.statusSource: the selected compiled node verification.status after declared dependency propagation

selection.included: exactly the unique node ids declared by route.nodes
selection.excluded: every node not declared by route.nodes
selection.claimDocumentSourceRule: claim, document, implementation, evidence, and other node kinds use the same id-revision-status entry; provider and source coordinates bind through the node revision and the enclosing authority root

beforeRoots: route visibility broader than a selected node
missing human or Agent parity peer
different selected-node sets within a parity group
different route resolution intent within a parity group
failure.behavior: emit a non-qualifying validation receipt and no compiled roots

enclosingRoots.contextIrAuthority: hashes cut, every compiled node, and every edge; route exclusion does not remove global authority
enclosingRoots.contextPack: binds the compiled routes, their two roots, and the global component roots
enclosingRoots.atlas: binds the exact verified Context Pack bytes and the published Atlas schema root
